O.outcome_detail: number of included studies using each mind-wandering assessment approach

cells.quote: An equal number of studies unobtrusively measured mind wandering through multimodal data streams (e.g., eye tracking, physiology, reaction time), with 27% utilizing machine learning (ML) techniques for assessment.
cells.note: The review reports descriptive study counts rather than an inferential comparison or learning outcome; therefore direction is not coded.

D.treatment: cognitive and metacognitive SRL processes examined alongside mind wandering
D.comparison: affective and motivational SRL processes examined alongside mind wandering

O.outcome_detail: extent of SRL-process coverage in mind-wandering studies

cells.quote: Our analysis revealed that a significant number of studies have examined mind wandering alongside cognitive and metacognitive SRL processes and predominantly using self-report measures. ... Overall, affective and motivational processes received little to no attention.
cells.note: Descriptive systematic-review synthesis; the contrast concerns research coverage, not a learner outcome.

D.comparison: unobtrusive multimodal measurement of mind wandering

cells.quote: Our analysis revealed that a significant number of studies have examined mind wandering alongside cognitive and metacognitive SRL processes and predominantly using self-report measures. An equal number of studies unobtrusively measured mind wandering through multimodal data streams (e.g., eye tracking, physiology, reaction time), with 27% utilizing machine learning (ML) techniques for assessment.
cells.note: The review reports predominance for self-report in one aspect of the synthesis but an equal number of unobtrusive multimodal studies overall; no inferential effect size applies.

D.treatment: integrated multimodal assessment combined with SRL processes
D.comparison: mind-wandering assessment without integrated SRL procedures

O.outcome_detail: integration of multimodal mind-wandering assessment with SRL

cells.quote: However, most of these reports did not include SRL procedures and only a small number of studies used an integrated analytic approach, combining multimodal assessment and including SRL processes.
cells.note: Descriptive systematic-review synthesis; the direction indicates fewer integrated studies than non-integrated reports, not poorer learning performance.
